# Harvard Library

> Harvard Library provides comprehensive research services, digital collections access, and specialized tools including HOLLIS catalog, special collections discovery, and document delivery for Harvard students, faculty, alumni, and visitors.

Harvard Library serves as the central hub for Harvard University's extensive library system, offering access to millions of items across multiple libraries and collections. The system includes specialized libraries like Houghton Library, Harvard-Yenching Library, and Loeb Music Library, along with innovative discovery and delivery services.

## Key Topics

- HOLLIS catalog
- Special Collections and Archives
- Scan & Deliver service
- Collections Explorer
- Interlibrary Loan
- Harvard-Yenching Library
- Houghton Library
- Course Reserves
- Visitor Access
- Alumni Access
- Research Support
- Digital Collections
- Loeb Music Library
- Harvard Map Collection
- Library Tools and Services

## Getting Started

- [Harvard Library Homepage](https://library.harvard.edu): Harvard Library homepage featuring HOLLIS catalog, research services, and digital collections
- [Services and Tools](https://library.harvard.edu/services-tools): Overview of Harvard Library services, tools, borrowing, and special collections
- [Choose a Search Tool](https://library.harvard.edu/how-to/choose-search-tool): Beginner guide to choosing appropriate search tools for different research types
- [About Harvard Library](https://library.harvard.edu/visit-about/about-harvard-library): Overview of Harvard Library mission, vision, and institutional framework

## Collections and Discovery

- [Use Special Collections and Archives](https://library.harvard.edu/how-to/use-special-collections-and-archives): How-to guide for requesting and viewing special collections and archives items
- [Collections Explorer](https://library.harvard.edu/services-tools/collections-explorer): Guide to Collections Explorer, an AI-powered discovery tool for special collections
- [Exhibits](https://library.harvard.edu/collections/exhibits): Showcases library exhibits across music, maps, and special collections

## Borrowing and Access

- [Borrow, Renew, and Return Library Materials](https://library.harvard.edu/how-to/borrow-renew-and-return-library-materials): How-to guide for borrowing, renewing materials, and using Scan & Deliver service
- [Scan & Deliver](https://library.harvard.edu/services-tools/scan-deliver): Documentation for Scan & Deliver service for document digitization and delivery
- [Use Harvard Library as an Alum](https://library.harvard.edu/how-to/use-harvard-library-alum): Guide for alumni accessing electronic resources and visiting Harvard libraries
- [Visitor Access](https://library.harvard.edu/visitor-access): Information on visitor access, borrowing cards, and public events at Harvard libraries

## Research and Teaching Support

- [Get Support for Research & Publishing](https://library.harvard.edu/how-to/get-support-research-publishing): Guide to research support, publishing resources, and scholarly communications services
- [Teach with Harvard Library](https://library.harvard.edu/how-to/teach-harvard-library): Guide for faculty on course reserves, library instruction, and teaching tools

## Community and Events

- [Harvard Library Events Calendar](https://libcal.library.harvard.edu/calendar/main): Event calendar for Harvard Library programming and academic events
- [Grants & Fellowships](https://library.harvard.edu/visit-about/grants-fellowships): Grants and fellowship opportunities including Pforzheimer Fellowships and awards
- [News](https://library.harvard.edu/about/news): News and updates about Harvard Library developments and initiatives
